name: @rhema/obligations
description: Revision obligations (§11.7; REQ-OBJ-2..8, REQ-WF-7/15, REQ-DATA-26): the one deliberately mutable object over the immutable record. Owns obligation semantics end-to-end — spawn at dossier delivery (the mirror's ObligationHook), disposition routing, the closed-world discharge paths, cross-round lineage matching, the §6.8 stall query feeding the Decisions inbox, the REQ-WF-7 carried/closed/new counts reconciled with the Editor's sidecar, and the read APIs the beta obligation surfaces consume (P0.12).
